Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 14.11.2022 has moved this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Doranda P.S. Case No.341 of 2022 registered under Sections 448, 307, 376, 511 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 8 of the POCSO Act.

As per the case of FIR, an attempt of rape was committed with the minor daughter of the informant by extending threat to her life during day time when she was alone in her house by one Shyam regarding which the FIR was lodged on 11.11.2022.

During investigation Shyam was not identified by the victim as being involved in the incidence, and on the basis of the CCTV footage the petitioner was identified as the person involved who had been wrongly named in the FIR.
The victim has named this petitioner in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
After investigation chargesheet has been submitted against the petitioner.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is not named in the FIR and he has been wrongly been made at the behest of the siter of the accused Shyam.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is a labourer and he does not have criminal antecedent.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioner.
It is submitted that the victim identified the petitioner on the basis of CCTV footage from which identity of the accused was established.

It is submitted that victim is a minor of 9 years old and, therefore, there was some minor discrepancy in her statement.
Considering the nature of allegation and gravity of offence
, I am not inclined to enlarge the Amit Tirkey vs The State Of Jharkhand.
